name: Front of Misericordia Church, Macao
dimensions: Dimensions taken from <u>Victoria & Albert Museum Department of Prints and Drawings and Department of Paintings, Accessions 1928. </u> London: HMSO, 1929
summary: A view looking north-east up the Largo do Senado, Macau: on the right figures approach the entrance to the church of Santa Casa da Misericordia (see also E.1732-1928 and E.1734-1928).
